review.official:
Sora is a pop idol who is temporarily lodging with
Penguin Logistics
. She became a member of
Rhodes Island
after the two organizations began their partnership. Using her special techniques, she is able to channel her
Arts
through her voice to support allies with her unique songs.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Sora showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Sora rarely comes into contact with Originium.

A minor celebrity/pop idol girl in Lungmen. 
Cute, playful, vivacious, the epitome of the word 'girl.' 
Still cannot strike a balance between being an idol and an Operator, but is making strides.

Miss Sora could've chosen a more conventional fighting style, but at her own insistence, Dr. Kal'tsit ultimately designed a custom program for her to better develop her natural talent. 
To her credit, Sora put in way more effort than a typical support Operator. Anyone would admit that she was practically born to sing, and the results of this program surpassed all expectations. 
Of course, someone who sings on a battlefield draws plenty of enemy attention, so Sora requires more bodyguards than usual. However, she is certainly worth the strategic compromise.

Penguin Logistics naturally had to 'negotiate' with Sora's management agency in order to allow a pop idol to become a courier. 
Given that a codename was also part of the package, it's fair to assume that the 'negotiation' wasn't conventional at all, because no agency in its right mind would expose its valuable asset to potential harm without getting something in return. 
Rhodes Island is a fair operation, and for the other party to make such a great compromise, Penguin Logistics certainly would pay a huge cost without any underhanded coercion. 
Then, what is the cost for Sora to become a PL Operator while retaining her pop idol status? The official contract is too long and complicated to go into here, though it could probably be summed up in three clauses: 
One, Penguin Logistics is responsible for Sora's personal safety, and must not let her make any appearance that would damage her image as a pop idol. 
Two, wherever Sora goes on a mission, Penguin Logistics is obligated to do their best to promote her and increase her popularity as they see fit, as well as absorbing all costs incurred. 
Three, including events or activities described in Clause 2, all revenue derived from Sora's performance as an entertainer must go to the management agency. 
Violation of any clause is ground for the agency to terminate the contract to revoke Sora as an Operator. 
Following PL's partnership with Rhodes Island, the latter also assumed all the obligations. After all, who wouldn't want a girl as adorable as Sora to be the biggest star in the world?

People always ask: Maybe Sora is a good entertainer, but is she a good Operator? 
The answer is affirmative. 
She's not too hung up about needing someone to protect her, nor does she wallow in self-pity over not able to defend others with a weapon. She knows her limits and stays within them. No one has to worry about that. 
However, that doesn't mean she wishes harm to come to those who guard her, nor does it mean she refuses to pick up arms in defense of others. She's no good at it, but that doesn't keep her from trying. 
Every day between practice sessions, Sora clumsily trains her weapon proficiency, hoping to contribute a bit more in battle. 
It's thoughts like that which truly make Sora special.

That Sora lass, she managed to fool her fans with impeccable illusions, making them believe she's Lupo. 
Perhaps she thought she'd stand out as a Lupo? That does make sense from the trendy perspective... 
And that kid, I've seen idols before and they didn't impress me. But then Sora came along and I finally understood why some people worship stars. 
Anyway, I taught her an even better way of concealment, usable at any time, so she won't ever need to try to cover her own identity anymore. 
Also, I shall design more attire for her to help further her career. 
—Orchid

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yahoo, Doctor! Whacha doing? Looks like fun!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Does Rhodes Island have a karaoke place? It'd be great if we had a place to sing the night away, especially when we don't have battles to fight!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My job as an idol is to make the fans happy with my songs and performances. But what should I do as an operator of Rhodes Island... ?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hi, hi, Doctor! Anything I can help with? Don't judge me by my look— I actually do some heavy lifting at Penguin Logistics.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Yup, my special skill is singing! I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo yo! But, I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator. If only I had a more practical skill…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: M-My ears...? Uh, I can't tell you! A-And even if you ask Texas, she's not going to tell you either! Ehhh—Sorry, I'll explain if I get the chance someday…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You know, Texas actually saved my life. She also taught me so much I never knew. Which is why I... want to be there with her whenever I can... I, uhh, I'm just trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas again, right? If only I were as good as Exusiai…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor! Could you teach me to use a weapon? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with a weapon... What? You're not good at fighting either?!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Texas... are you listening to my song?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Aww…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Leveling—up!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Do we also have an idol ranking on Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I can feel the surge in my heart. It's like back to my first concert. I'm just delighted that you trust me so much, Doctor! All my hard work has paid off! Hmm? My ears? Wh-What about them?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As a squad member, I'll try my best to learn from the basics!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the leader? Is that like standing at the center of the idol group?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Singing on the battlefield... Now that's a fresh experience!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If only my music could put an end to all this fighting...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes, I can handle this!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's show time!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Alright, let's make some noise!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come on, we can do it!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You have my full support!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Now we change the game!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't lose heart, we can win this one!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, did you see how I sparkled on the stage?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We did a good job, team. Thank you for your hard work!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... I wasn't good enough to be your help...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Sparkle spark!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It looks like I can't hold a solo live this year, but that doesn't change my desire to sing. Happy New Year! This year, I'm going to bring even more smiles to my fans—um, no, that's not the word... Oh, right! I'm going to bring even more music to everyone at Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A lot of fans say my singing can bring people true happiness, and I really hope they're right. Doctor, today I've got a song just for you. Happy birthday! This is for a beautiful life and a cheerful you, all year long!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Idols and Messengers are both jobs about passing on love. Seeing fans and audiences smile is a source of happiness in my own life. I'm sure, together with everyone at Rhodes Island, we can spread this blessing even further. It's a tiny little dream, but I'll do my best to make it come true!
